structured_output.summary: Act 45 of 2025 created Pennsylvania's Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit, codified at Fiscal Code Art. XVI-W.2. The credit equals 10% of the federal EITC, is refundable, and applies to taxable years beginning after 12/31/2024, which includes 2026. This head of household has 3 qualifying children, $60,000 of earned income and $60,010 of AGI. Under the Rev. Proc. 2025-32 parameters (maximum credit $8,231, phase-out from $23,890 at 21.06%), the federal EITC is $624.13, so the WPTC is $62.41. The engine's steps match the law, and the consensus answer of $0 overlooks the new credit. The only possible difference is a few cents if the federal EITC is rounded to the IRS $50-bracket table (about $62.10).
